top_violation_types.title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §746.4505)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no storage space for each child's person belongings in the infant room, two toddler rooms, and pre-k room.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A television was not anchored to the table it was sitting on.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregiver was observed to not wash the infant's hands before eating.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping in a swing.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The center director does not have proof of having completed orientation on file.

top_violation_types.title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguishers have not been inspected monthly.
